patient_persona.description: Norhayati binti Mansor, 53, female, school librarian in Subang Jaya; type 2 diabetes on metformin and a mechanical heart valve on warfarin. First visit. Clear, measured voice, English-dominant Malay who mixes in Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Daniel Chew Wei Liang, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, family medicine specialist at a Subang Jaya clinic. Thorough, soft-spoken; English-leaning, mirrors her Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, my left shoulder has been stiff for five months already. Now I can't even tie my tudung properly, cannot reach behind.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Did it start after a fall or injury, or on its own? Ada terjatuh ke?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: On its own. First it was sakit waktu malam, now it's more stiff than painful. Tak boleh baring on that side langsung.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let me move it for you. Try lift your arm to the side... okay, stops around here. And rotating outwards, very limited.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: This looks like frozen shoulder, adhesive capsulitis. It's more common in people with diabetes, especially women your age.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Frozen shoulder? My friend said nanti baik sendiri.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It does improve, but it can take one to two years. We can make it faster and less painful.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: The farmasi gave me Voltaren tablets. I took them for one week, then my gusi started bleeding.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's important. Diclofenac with warfarin boleh naikkan risiko berdarah. Please stop the Voltaren, and we'll check your INR today.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, dah stop. So what can I take untuk sakit?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Paracetamol 1 gram up to four times a day is safe with warfarin. Guna hot pack sebelum buat senaman, it helps loosen the shoulder.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My cousin had an injection for the same thing, dia kata terus lega. Can I have that?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: A steroid injection into the joint can help a lot in this painful stage. With warfarin it can still be done, but your INR must be in range, and it will raise your sugar for a few days.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, I'm fine with that asalkan selamat. My HbA1c last time was 7.8, tak berapa baik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Then we check your INR first, and I'll refer you to physio. Every day do the pendulum and wall-climbing exercises, sikit-sikit, don't force through sharp pain.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you, doctor. I really miss tidur mengiring on my left side.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Come back next week with the INR result, and we'll book the injection.

patient_persona.description: Chua Kim Seng, 58, male, runs a hardware shop in Kajang, lifts paint tins and pipes; type 2 diabetes. Follow-up six weeks after a shoulder injection. Loud, blunt Malaysian Mandarin with Hokkien words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Loh Siew Peng, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, sports medicine physician at a Kajang hospital. Lively, direct; English-leaning, speaks Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 蔡先生，打针到现在六个礼拜了，肩膀怎样？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 痛是少了很多，晚上可以睡了。但是手还是举不高，拿上面架子的东西还是要叫工人。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我看看。手举起来……现在一百一十度，上次是八十度，有进步。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 进步是有啦，但是我以为打了 injection 就会全好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那个针是止痛和消炎，给你机会做 exercise。真正让它松开的，是每天拉筋。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 老实说，我在店里很忙，一天只做一次，有时候 lupa。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 最好一天三次，每次五分钟。你可以用店里的 door frame，手慢慢爬上去，爬到有点紧就停十秒。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 这个可以。我的 sugar 打针以后高了两个礼拜，十二、十三那样。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Steroid 会这样，现在应该回来了。你今天的 HbA1c 是 7.5，还可以。糖控制好，肩膀也会好得比较快。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我可以再打一针吗？Boleh ka?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以，但是不急。Three months 内不要打超过一次。如果 physio 做了三个月都没 improvement，我们可以考虑 hydrodilatation。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 什么东西来的？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 就是用 ultrasound 看着，打很多 saline 进去把关节撑开。不用开刀，门诊就可以做。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，先继续拉。那我可以搬 cat 桶吗？Paint 很重的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 重的先用右手，或者叫 worker 搬。两个月后回来，我们再 measure 角度。

condition: Frozen shoulder, first visit after traditional massage

patient_persona.description: Zaleha binti Harun, 49, female, primary school teacher in Kuantan, Pahang; hypothyroidism on thyroxine. First visit. Gentle, slightly anxious voice, east coast Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kevin Ong Jia Hao, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, GP at a Kuantan clinic. Calm, explanatory; English-leaning but speaks mostly Malay with Malay patients.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, bahu kanan saya ni dah empat bulan sakit. Nak sikat rambut pun susah, nak tulis kat papan hitam pun tak sampai atas.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada jatuh atau terhentak sebelum ni? Any injury?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada. Mak saya kata angin masuk, dah pergi urut dua kali. Lepas urut lagi teruk, tiga hari tak boleh angkat tangan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Urut kuat-kuat kat bahu yang tengah inflamed memang boleh jadi lagi sakit. Sekarang sakit waktu malam?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Malam paling teruk, doktor. Tidur mengiring kanan terus terjaga.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan ada sakit tiroid, kan? Masih makan thyroxine?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ya, thyroxine 100 microgram setiap pagi. Tapi dah lama tak check darah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Masalah tiroid dan kencing manis memang kaitan dengan frozen shoulder. Hari ni kita check TSH dan gula sekali.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dari pemeriksaan, bahu puan keras semua arah. Ini frozen shoulder, bukan angin. The muscle is not torn, tapi joint capsule dah jadi tebal dan ketat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Boleh baik ke, doktor? Saya risau tak boleh mengajar, SPM dah dekat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh baik, cuma ambil masa. Saya bagi naproxen 500mg dua kali sehari lepas makan, dua minggu, dan refer physio.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kat rumah, buat exercise pendulum: bongkok sikit, biar tangan tergantung, pusing kecil-kecil, sepuluh kali, tiga kali sehari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Urut boleh teruskan tak? Mak saya mesti tanya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Urut kuat tak payah dulu. Kalau nak, sapu minyak dan tuam air suam je, lembut-lembut.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Nanti result darah macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya call puan kalau result tak normal. Datang balik tiga minggu, we'll review your progress and the blood test.

condition: Frozen shoulder, physio review and referral

patient_persona.description: Juliana Gimbang, 56, female, Kadazan church choir member and retired government clerk in Penampang, Sabah; diabetes. Follow-up after three months of physio. Warm, lilting Sabahan Malay with English words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Syafiq bin Abdullah, Sabahan Malay man in his 30s, medical officer at a Kota Kinabalu health clinic. Friendly, relaxed; English-leaning, speaks Sabah-style Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Selamat pagi, Puan Juliana. Macam mana bahu kiri, any improvement?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Selamat pagi, doktor. Sakit tu kurang sudah bah, tapi keras masih ada. Physio pun kata tak banyak beza.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Report physio kata abduction still 90 degrees, same as last month. Exercise di rumah buat hari-hari?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hari-hari, doktor. Pagi dengan malam. Anak saya pun tolong tarik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus, tapi jangan suruh anak tarik kuat-kuat, nanti tercedera. Let the shoulder move by itself, perlahan-lahan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, begitu. Saya ingat lagi kuat tarik lagi cepat baik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Gula puan macam mana? HbA1c bulan lepas 9.2, tinggi.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Itulah, doktor. Masa Krismas saya banyak makan kek, lupa diri sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Faham, puan. Tapi gula tinggi buat frozen shoulder lambat baik. Kita naikkan metformin ke 1 gram dua kali sehari.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sebab physio tak banyak progress, saya nak refer ke orthopaedic di hospital KK for hydrodilatation. They inject fluid under ultrasound to stretch the joint.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kena tidur hospital ka?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak payah, daycare je. Masuk pagi, petang boleh balik. Lepas tu terus physio.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay lah, doktor. Choir saya nak buat konsert bulan Jun, saya mau angkat tangan konduktor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita cuba sampai sebelum Jun. Appointment ortho mungkin dalam enam minggu. Teruskan exercise, dan jaga gula.

patient_persona.description: Lau Siew Kuan, 61, female, retired primary school teacher in Kluang, Johor, who dances line dance at the community hall; prediabetes. Results review. Gentle, articulate Malaysian Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Yeo Chin Hong, Malaysian Chinese man in his 50s, GP in Kluang. Warm, unhurried; English-leaning, fluent Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 刘老师，你的 shoulder ultrasound 报告出来了。Rotator cuff 没有断，只是 capsule 比较厚。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那就是说，是五十肩？Frozen shoulder 就是五十肩？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，就是 frozen shoulder，我们华人叫五十肩。好消息是不用开刀。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我朋友去做针灸和推拿，说很有效。我可以去吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 针灸可以试，有些人觉得止痛有帮助。推拿不要太大力，关节在 inflamed 的时候，用力扭会更痛。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 上个礼拜去推拿，师傅很大力，回来三天手都不能动。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那就是太大力了。你现在的 pain score，零到十，大概几分？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 白天四分，晚上会到七分，常常痛醒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 晚上痛那么多，我建议打一针 steroid 进关节，可以帮你睡觉，也让 physio 做得下去。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 打针会不会让我的糖升高？我是 prediabetes。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 会高几天，所以那几天少吃甜的，不用太担心。打完之后，每天在家做 stretching exercise，very important。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那 line dance 呢？我们下个月有表演。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 手不要举过头，其他动作可以跳。其实 exercise 对 shoulder 好，只要不痛到受不了。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，那就打吧。打针痛吗？我很怕针的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 会有一点胀，我们会先打 local anaesthetic。今天就可以做，做完 ice pack 十五分钟。

patient_persona.description: Muhammad Irfan bin Zulkarnain, 22, male, engineering student at a university in Shah Alam who plays futsal; asthma. First visit, day two after injury. Young, casual, fast English with lots of Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chan Mun Yee, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, GP at a Shah Alam clinic. Upbeat, quick; English-leaning, relaxed Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, I twisted my ankle playing futsal two nights ago. Kaki masuk dalam, then got a pop sound. Now it's swollen like a bun.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Could you walk right after it happened, or kawan kena angkat you keluar?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I could limp to the car, like four steps lah. But next morning totally cannot put weight.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let me press a few spots. Sakit sini? Yang ni, tulang belakang buku lali, sakit tak?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sini sakit, the front part. The bone part not really.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. The bones aren't tender, and you could take four steps after the injury. Based on the Ottawa rules, we don't need an X-ray.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: This is a lateral ligament sprain, grade two I think. Ligamen tu terkoyak sikit, but it heals well with the right care.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. I've been taking ibuprofen, 800mg, like four times a day. My housemate cakap makan banyak, cepat baik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's too much, and you have asthma, right? Ibuprofen can sometimes trigger wheezing. Any chest tight?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Actually semalam dada ketat sikit, I puffed Ventolin two times.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Then stop the ibuprofen. Tukar paracetamol 1 gram, empat kali sehari. Kalau semput makin teruk, datang balik terus.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For the ankle: ice fifteen minutes every two hours, compression bandage, and angkat kaki tinggi sikit when you rest.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Crutches need or not? Kelas saya on the third floor, tak ada lift.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll lend you crutches for a few days. Start putting weight as the pain allows, don't keep it totally still.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bila boleh main futsal balik, doctor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Around four to six weeks. Do the balance exercises first, stand on one leg. Kalau main terlalu awal, you'll sprain it again.

condition: Ankle sprain after a fall at the market

patient_persona.description: Dayang Norazlina binti Awang, 35, female, sells kek lapis at the Satok weekend market in Kuching, Sarawak; slipped on a wet floor. First visit after an emergency department X-ray. Bright, fast Sarawak Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Alvin Wong Tze Ming, Sarawakian Chinese man in his 30s, GP at a Kuching clinic. Calm, friendly; English-leaning, speaks Sarawak-flavoured Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, kamek jatuh kat pasar hari Sabtu. Lantai basah, kaki kiri terpelecok. Hospital dah buat X-ray, katanya tak patah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada bawa report X-ray? Oh ada, OK. Tak ada fracture, betul. Sekarang sakit macam mana?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bengkak masih ada, biru-biru sampai tapak kaki. Jalan boleh, tapi terhencot-hencot.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Lebam turun ke tapak kaki tu biasa lepas sprain, the blood follows gravity. Don't worry, jangan risau.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hospital bagi crepe bandage. Kamek pakai sampai tidur malam, betul ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Waktu tidur buka dulu, biar darah jalan elok. Siang pakai balik, jangan ikat ketat sangat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, patutlah pagi jari kaki kebas sikit. I ingat ada problem saraf.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, sebab ketat sangat. Ubat apa yang hospital bagi?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Paracetamol dengan krim. Tapi makcik kamek suruh tuam dengan minyak panas.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Minggu pertama ni tuam ais dulu, bukan panas. Panas buat lagi bengkak. Lepas seminggu baru boleh air suam.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kamek kena berdiri jual kek hari Sabtu ni. Boleh ka?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh berdiri, tapi pakai kasut yang ada support, jangan selipar. Take a chair, sit down every hour or so.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya tambah etoricoxib 90mg sekali sehari, lima hari je, lepas makan. Gastrik ada?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada gastrik. Terima kasih, doktor. Thank you ya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau dua minggu masih tak boleh jalan elok, datang balik, kita refer physio.

condition: Ankle sprain in a teenager, parent attending

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Tan Pei Wen, 42, female, accountant in Bayan Lepas, Penang, speaking for her 14-year-old son Jun Hao, who injured his ankle at school basketball. First visit. Anxious, quick Malaysian Mandarin; the boy answers a little.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lim Chee Keong, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, GP in Bayan Lepas. Easy-going, reassuring; English-leaning, speaks Mandarin to the family.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我儿子昨天在学校打篮球，跳下来踩到别人的脚，脚踝扭到了。肿得很大。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 俊豪，你当时可以自己走吗？Can walk or not?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 他说是同学扶着走到 canteen 的。回到家就一直喊痛，晚上都没睡好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我按一下哦。这里痛吗？这边骨头呢？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 他说骨头那边也很痛，脚掌外面这里也痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 外面这块骨头按下去痛，要照 X-ray。小孩子的 growth plate 还没 close，有时候看起来是 sprain，其实是 fracture。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 骨头裂？Crack？那很严重吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 先不要紧张，我们照了 X-ray 才知道。就算有小 crack，打石膏几个礼拜就会好。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好的。我昨晚给他擦了 minyak angin，还用热毛巾敷。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 头两天不要热敷，会更肿。用冰，用毛巾包着，一次十五分钟。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 知道了。他下个礼拜有 competition，还可以打吗？他是 school team 的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 下个礼拜肯定不行。就算只是扭伤，也要三到四个礼拜。太早打，以后很容易再扭。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 痛的话，paracetamol 500mg，一天四次。他体重五十公斤，这个剂量可以。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: X-ray 在哪里照？今天可以吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我们 clinic 就可以照，大概二十分钟。等 report 出来，我再跟你们讲。

condition: Ankle sprain in a technician on high-dose painkillers

patient_persona.description: Kong Wai Loon, 38, male, air-conditioning technician in Seremban who climbs ladders daily; hypertension on perindopril, self-started aspirin. First visit, day two after a futsal injury. Brisk, slightly defensive Malaysian Mandarin mixed with Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Norazura binti Kassim, Malay woman in her 40s, GP in Seremban. Direct, kind; English-leaning, speaks English and Malay, and some simple Mandarin.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor，我前天踢 futsal 扭到脚，右边。现在还是很肿，但是我明天一定要开工，kerja tak boleh tunggu。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay, Encik Kong. Your job involves climbing ladders, right? Aircond on the wall?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 对，每天都要爬 tangga，有时候上屋顶。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ligament tu dah koyak sikit, but no fracture on the X-ray. Standing on a ladder with this ankle is dangerous.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 可是我不做工就没有钱。我自己 part-time 的，没有 MC 这回事。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I understand. Apa ubat you dah ambil since the injury?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Nurofen，一次两粒，一天四五次。还有我每天吃的 aspirin，一粒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Aspirin tu siapa bagi? Doctor prescribe?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有，我自己在 farmasi 买的。朋友说吃了可以防 heart attack。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. Aspirin plus high-dose ibuprofen, dengan darah tinggi you, boleh rosakkan perut dan buah pinggang, and makes the bruising worse. Stop both for now.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哦……难怪我的脚那么紫，biru-biru。那痛怎么办？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Paracetamol 1 gram, empat kali sehari. Ice and elevate. For the aspirin, we'll discuss your heart risk properly next visit, don't simply take it.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kerja ground level only for two weeks. Tak boleh naik tangga, tak boleh panjat bumbung. Saya tulis surat untuk majikan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 两个礼拜……好啦，我叫我的 partner 爬，我在下面做 wiring。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's a good plan, bagus. Pakai ankle brace masa kerja, and come back in ten days.

patient_persona.description: Thivya a/p Rajendran, 29, female, Zumba and fitness instructor in Ipoh; third sprain of the same ankle in a year. Follow-up. Energetic, clear Malaysian Indian English with some Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ahmad Zulkifli bin Hassan, Malay man in his 40s, sports medicine physician at an Ipoh hospital. Encouraging, precise; English-leaning, occasional Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hi Thivya. So this is the third time the right ankle went, correct?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes doctor, third time this year. Last week just turun stage during class, it rolled again. Very malu in front of my aunties.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Between sprains, does the ankle feel wobbly, like it might give way on uneven ground?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, especially on the rumput or walking over the longkang cover. I don't trust it anymore.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your drawer test today shows more laxity on the right than the left. The ligaments have healed long, not tight.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Means what, the ligament dah longgar?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, more or less. We call it chronic ankle instability. Good news dia, kebanyakan orang baik dengan physio, tak perlu operation.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Last two times I just rehat, then went back to teaching after one week.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's likely why it keeps happening. Rest heals the pain, but the balance sensors in the ankle need retraining.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Physio will do proprioception and peroneal strengthening for about six to eight weeks. Wobble board, single-leg balance, resistance band.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Can I still teach Zumba during that time? Kalau tak, no income lah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Low-impact classes with an ankle brace, yes. No jumping or quick side steps for the first month.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: What about an MRI? Nak tahu ada koyak ke tak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If after eight weeks of physio it's still giving way, we'll do an MRI and see an orthopaedic surgeon about repair.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, fair. Ada ubat I need to take?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Not much now. Paracetamol if sore after class. The key is doing the exercises every day, sikit pun tak apa, but daily.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alright doctor, I'll be disciplined this time. Promise.
